annotations.title: China Z-Visa Work Permit Category A/B/C Points & Exemption Calculator

description: Score an applicant under the China SAFIEA work permit rubric (Category A >=85, Category B >=60, Category C <60), detect 6x local average wage or Top-100 PhD Category A exemptions, and prescribe lowest-cost point upgrades.

age.description: Applicant chronological age in years (18-45 earns maximum 15 points).

annualSalaryExceed6xAverage.description: Manual override flag confirming contracted annual pay reaches 6x municipal average wage for automatic Category A exemption.

cityTier.description: Employment city tier for local wage multiple benchmarking (tier1_super: Beijing/Shanghai; tier1: Shenzhen/Guangzhou/Hangzhou; tier2; other).

education.description: Highest academic degree awarded: phd, master, bachelor, or diploma_or_less.

emergencyDemandSector.description: Whether the role falls under regional AI, Semiconductor, Biotech, or Green Tech shortage talent catalogs (+10 pts).

fortune500Executive.description: Whether the applicant holds a Fortune Global 500 senior executive or technical specialist appointment.

hskLevel.description: Certified HSK Mandarin proficiency test level (none up to hsk6).

internationalAwardWinner.description: Whether the applicant holds a globally recognized scientific or industrial achievement award.

localFtzIncentive.description: Whether the employer entity operates in a Free Trade Zone or National Hi-Tech Park (+5 municipal points).

monthlySalaryRMB.description: Contracted gross monthly base compensation in Chinese Yuan (RMB).

topUniversityGrad.description: Whether the degree is from a QS, THE, or ARWU Global Top-100 university (+5 bonus or PhD Category A bypass).

workExperienceYears.description: Total post-graduation full-time relevant employment years.

workLocationType.description: Regional policy zone: standard, encouraged_region, or remote_western (+5 to +10 pts).
